basis: kg CO2e per activity unit: CO2, CH4 and N2O at IPCC AR5 GWP-100, unless a source's own basis says otherwise
note: Single source of truth for emission factors, consumed by emissions-engine.cjs (server, CSV import) and src/lib/emission-factors (client calculator). A catalog version is immutable once any row may have been priced with it: this file prices new entries and previews, emission-factors.v1.json (version 2026-07-24, frozen) prices every row stored without a pin, and a row's catalog_version decides which one prices and classifies it. Change a factor here only together with a new `version` (tests/catalog-version.test.ts checks emission-factors.versions.json). Every source carries factorSource, which must match an id in src/lib/emission-factors/registry.ts and in `datasets` below. Units are explicit: a factor is only valid for the units listed under it. Classification is data: `reportingBucket` moves a whole source out of its category's scope (memo:non-kyoto), `biogenicCO2` is kg of biogenic CO2 per unit reported outside the scopes, and a category's `marketBasedShare` scales its location-based Scope 2 value into the market-based total (0 for zero-emission contracts; every other Scope 2 row reports the same value market-based as location-based, because no residual-mix factor is applied).
